checks.sql: select count(*) from AR_UPD_CUSTOMERS where load_request_id = ?

scopeResolver.sql: SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(c.LOAD_REQUEST_ID) AS SCOPE_KEY, 'FSCR_CUSTOMERS_' || TO_CHAR(c.LOAD_REQUEST_ID) AS BATCH_NAME, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) AS DOCUMENT_ID, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS BATCH_ID, 'ESSCREATE' AS LOAD_MODE, c.LOAD_REQUEST_ID AS IMPORT_PROCESS_ID FROM AR_UPD_CUSTOMERS c WHERE c.LOAD_REQUEST_ID = ? ORDER BY 1

summary.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS status_total_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN c.UPLOAD_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_success_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN c.UPLOAD_STATUS IN ('FAILED', 'FAILED_NOT_CORRECTABLE', 'BLOCKED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_error_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN c.UPLOAD_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' OR c.UPLOAD_STATUS IN ('FAILED', 'FAILED_NOT_CORRECTABLE', 'BLOCKED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0) AS status_pending_count FROM AR_UPD_CUSTOMERS c WHERE c.LOAD_REQUEST_ID = ?

errors.sql: WITH failed_rows AS ( SELECT c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID, c.LOAD_REQUEST_ID, c.BATCH_ID, c.FILE_RECORD_NUM, c.UPLOAD_STATUS, c.ORIG_SOURCE_SYSTEM, JSON_OBJECT('uploadId' VALUE TO_CHAR(c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID), 'ORIG_SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME' VALUE c.ORIG_SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME, 'PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE' VALUE c.PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE, 'CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE' VALUE c.CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE, 'CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYS_REF' VALUE c.CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYS_REF, 'LOCATION_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE' VALUE c.LOCATION_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE, 'CUST_SITEUSE_ORIG_SYS_REF' VALUE c.CUST_SITEUSE_ORIG_SYS_REF, 'SITE_USE_CODE' VALUE c.SITE_USE_CODE NULL ON NULL RETURNING CLOB) AS row_identity FROM AR_UPD_CUSTOMERS c WHERE c.LOAD_REQUEST_ID = ? AND c.UPLOAD_STATUS IN ('FAILED', 'FAILED_NOT_CORRECTABLE', 'BLOCKED') ), linked_errors AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID, TO_CHAR(c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID) || ':' || TO_CHAR(e.CUST_ERROR_ID) AS error_key, 'FSCR_ROW_V1=' || CASE WHEN DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(c.row_identity) <= 600 AND LENGTHB(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.row_identity, 600, 1)) <= 600 THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.row_identity, 600, 1) ELSE JSON_OBJECT('uploadId' VALUE TO_CHAR(c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID), 'identityOmitted' VALUE 'length' RETURNING VARCHAR2(100)) END || ' ' || 'Message=' || SUBSTR(NVL(e.ERROR_MESSAGE_NAME, 'UNAVAILABLE'), 1, 100) || ', original=' || SUBSTR(NVL(e.ORIGINAL_ERROR_MESSAGE, 'UNAVAILABLE'), 1, 100) || ', interface=' || SUBSTR(NVL(e.INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME, 'UNAVAILABLE'), 1, 100) || CASE WHEN e.TOKEN1_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' || SUBSTR(e.TOKEN1_NAME, 1, 30) || '=' || SUBSTR(NVL(e.TOKEN1_VALUE, '(null)'), 1, 70) ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN e.TOKEN2_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' || SUBSTR(e.TOKEN2_NAME, 1, 30) || '=' || SUBSTR(NVL(e.TOKEN2_VALUE, '(null)'), 1, 70) ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN e.TOKEN3_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' || SUBSTR(e.TOKEN3_NAME, 1, 30) || '=' || SUBSTR(NVL(e.TOKEN3_VALUE, '(null)'), 1, 70) ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN e.TOKEN4_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' || SUBSTR(e.TOKEN4_NAME, 1, 30) || '=' || SUBSTR(NVL(e.TOKEN4_VALUE, '(null)'), 1, 70) ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN e.TOKEN5_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' || SUBSTR(e.TOKEN5_NAME, 1, 30) || '=' || SUBSTR(NVL(e.TOKEN5_VALUE, '(null)'), 1, 70) ELSE '' END AS error_message, NVL(e.ERROR_MESSAGE_NAME, 'AR_UPD_CUSTOMERS_' || c.UPLOAD_STATUS) AS error_code, 'CUST_UPLOAD_ID=' || TO_CHAR(c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID) || ', BATCH_ID=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(c.BATCH_ID), '(unassigned)') || ', FILE_RECORD_NUM=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(c.FILE_RECORD_NUM), '(unassigned)') AS record_reference, TO_CHAR(c.LOAD_REQUEST_ID) AS scope_key FROM failed_rows c JOIN AR_UPD_ERROR_DETAILS d ON d.UPLOAD_OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'AR_UPD_CUSTOMERS' AND d.UPLOAD_OWNER_TABLE_ID = c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID AND d.ERROR_OWNER_TABLE_NAME = 'AR_UPD_CUST_ERRORS' JOIN AR_UPD_CUST_ERRORS e ON e.CUST_ERROR_ID = d.ERROR_OWNER_TABLE_ID AND e.BATCH_ID = c.BATCH_ID AND e.ORIG_SOURCE_SYSTEM = c.ORIG_SOURCE_SYSTEM AND e.REQUEST_ID = d.REQUEST_ID ), all_errors AS ( SELECT error_key, error_message, error_code, record_reference, scope_key FROM linked_errors UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID) || ':STATUS' AS error_key, 'FSCR_ROW_V1=' || CASE WHEN DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(c.row_identity) <= 600 AND LENGTHB(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.row_identity, 600, 1)) <= 600 THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.row_identity, 600, 1) ELSE JSON_OBJECT('uploadId' VALUE TO_CHAR(c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID), 'identityOmitted' VALUE 'length' RETURNING VARCHAR2(100)) END || ' ' || 'Customer upload status=' || c.UPLOAD_STATUS || ', no matching detailed error was found. Review this batch in Manage Customer Uploads and its ESS output.' AS error_message, 'AR_UPD_CUSTOMERS_' || c.UPLOAD_STATUS AS error_code, 'CUST_UPLOAD_ID=' || TO_CHAR(c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID) || ', BATCH_ID=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(c.BATCH_ID), '(unassigned)') || ', FILE_RECORD_NUM=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(c.FILE_RECORD_NUM), '(unassigned)') AS record_reference, TO_CHAR(c.LOAD_REQUEST_ID) AS scope_key FROM failed_rows c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM linked_errors e WHERE e.CUST_UPLOAD_ID = c.CUST_UPLOAD_ID ) ) SELECT error_key, error_message, error_code, record_reference, scope_key FROM all_errors ORDER BY scope_key, record_reference, error_key
